Intro.title: Construction expertise at the service of ambitious projects
Intro.text1: Since 2018, E-MPGT has made 25 years of experience in the construction and engineering trades available to its clients.
Intro.text2: We support construction and infrastructure projects by combining construction consulting, engineering, technical expertise, resources, sourcing, international logistics and technologies dedicated to the construction sector.
Intro.text3: Our approach is built on a concrete, hands-on knowledge of the field and a network of specialised skills and partners.

Eco.description: E-MPGT is building a network of partners in artificial intelligence, digital, BIM, architecture, visualisation, electric mobility and construction technologies. Our role: identify needs, mobilise the right expertise, connect players and coordinate resources.

Services.subtitle: E-MPGT works across four complementary fields.
Services.note: Expertise driven by field experience and results.

sections.title: Construction Consulting & Engineering
sections.text: E-MPGT supports project owners, companies and construction stakeholders in their construction, renovation and infrastructure projects.

sections.title: Construction Equipment & Materials Sourcing
sections.tagline: Find the right resources for every project.
sections.text: E-MPGT supports the research and acquisition of construction equipment, professional tools and materials, especially on second-hand markets and at auctions. Our sourcing activity seeks out opportunities matched to the technical, economic and geographical needs of projects.
items: Used construction equipment — Sourcing machines, equipment and professional tools available on second-hand markets.
Auctions — Identifying opportunities from professional auctions.
International sourcing — Finding suppliers, equipment and materials beyond usual supply channels.
Acquisition — Assistance in identifying, analysing and building relationships around opportunities.
sections.note: From search to delivery. Sourcing can be paired with a logistics setup to move resources to the project site.

sections.title: Reuse & Low-Carbon Materials
sections.text: E-MPGT develops solutions around the reuse of construction materials and equipment, the circular economy and low-carbon materials. Reuse requires mastering not only resource availability, but also identification, storage, transport and traceability.
items: Construction material reuse — Identifying existing resources that can be reused in new projects.
Equipment reuse — Sourcing professional equipment and tools that can have a second life.
Low-carbon materials — Sourcing solutions and materials that support project environmental goals.
Circular economy in construction — Connecting available resources with new needs.
sections.note: An approach that combines economic performance, resource availability and the transition of the construction sector.

sections.title: International Logistics & Transport
sections.tagline: From the source to the site.
sections.text: Buying equipment or finding a material is not enough: it must be delivered in good conditions. E-MPGT organises and coordinates international logistics operations for equipment, machinery and goods linked to construction projects.
items: Road transport — National and international flows.
Sea freight — Shipping equipment and goods by sea.
Air freight — Solutions for urgent or specific needs.
Customs & import-export — Coordinating the formalities required for international operations.
Storage & transit — Warehousing and intermediate storage solutions.
Door-to-door — Coordinating transport from source to site.

AboutHero.title: At the crossroads of technical expertise, strategic vision and smart innovation
AboutHero.text: Our group relies on strong human values and the exacting standards of major construction projects to build bespoke solutions. Through rigour, listening and co-construction, we turn every mission into a lever for collective performance.

About.historyTitle: The key steps that shaped our company

histoire.title: Foundations of an expertise
histoire.text: 17 years of field experience with major French construction firms, with a deep understanding of site realities and industry players.

histoire.title: Born of MPGT
histoire.text: Creation of MPGT, a company specialised in engineering consulting for the building sector. Goal: put experience at the service of ambitious projects.

histoire.title: Growth in France
histoire.text: A resolutely operational approach, close to the ground of the field. A differentiating consulting model that fits the reality of sites.

histoire.title: Creation of E-MPGT
histoire.text: Faced with the perfect French market and the rise of international opportunities, MPGT creates E-MPGT to build a high-value-added offer and export European know-how, especially to Africa.

histoire.title: International momentum
histoire.text: European engineering expertise and integration of cutting-edge technologies to power the transformation of territories.

values.title: Commitment
values.text: Method, rigour and determination. Meeting deadlines, controlling budgets and guaranteeing reliable working conditions.

values.title: Trust
values.text: The foundation of all our relationships, built on transparency, dependability and consistency in results.

values.title: Knowledge sharing
values.text: Training, coaching and growing teams strengthens the quality of projects over the long term.

values.title: Excellence

The services are defined contractually on a case-by-case basis via quote, contract or purchase order.

Its liability cannot be engaged in the event of delay attributable to the client, force majeure, incomplete or erroneous information provided by the client, or decisions taken independently by the client. In any case, E-MPGT's financial liability is limited to the amount of the service concerned.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
sections.body: All content of the site (texts, logos, visuals, documents) is the exclusive property of E-MPGT. Any reproduction, distribution or use without prior written authorisation is prohibited.

sections.title: 7. Confidentiality
sections.body: E-MPGT undertakes to treat all information transmitted in the context of a mission with confidentiality. Non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) may be signed at the request of the parties.

sections.title: 8. Personal data
sections.body: Data collected via the site is used solely to respond to requests, process services and ensure business follow-up. It is not passed on to third parties without consent, except where legally required.

sections.title: 9. Changes to the terms
sections.body: E-MPGT reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. The new terms enter into force upon publication on the site.

sections.title: 10. Applicable law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law applicable to the contracting company. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the registered office of the company issuing the contract.

sections.title: 11. Contact

CguPartners.title: General Terms of the Partner Programme
CguPartners.subtitle: Business Referral Programme — Last updated: 31/01/2026
CguPartners.intro: These terms govern participation in the Partner Programme offered by E-MPGT NIF: 518098427 Portugal (the 'Company'). Any registration to the programme implies full and complete acceptance of these terms.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of the programme
sections.body: The Partner Programme allows independent business referrers introduce potential clients to the Company in the following areas: construction & engineering consulting, expert secondment, equipment sourcing, international logistics. The Partner receives a commission under the conditions set out below.

sections.title: 2. Mandatory professional status
sections.body: The Partner must be a company, individual business or legally registered entrepreneur, hold a valid tax number, and be compliant with the tax and social obligations of their country. Private individuals are not eligible. The Partner acts as an independent professional. The programme does not constitute an employment contract nor a subordination relationship. The Partner has no authority to represent or bind the Company.

sections.title: 3. Declaration and validation of opportunities
sections.body: A business opportunity is considered valid if it is declared via the official programme platform, was not already being negotiated with the Company, and is validated in writing by the Company. The Company reserves the right to accept or refuse any opportunity.

sections.title: 4. Commission attribution conditions
sections.body: The commission is due only on amounts excluding tax, actually invoiced and fully collected by the Company. No commission is due for a simple contact, for an unsigned quote, or for unpaid invoices. The commission is definitively acquired only after effective collection.

sections.title: 5. Commission duration
sections.body: Unless a specific written agreement, the commission applies to the initial mission arising from the validated referral. Renewals, extensions or new contracts may be the subject of a separate agreement. No perpetual commission rights are granted.

sections.title: 6. Payment terms
sections.body: Validated commissions are paid monthly, after internal validation, subject to receipt of a compliant invoice issued by the Partner. Payment is made via Payoneer or international bank transfer. The Company will not make any payment without a compliant invoice. The Partner remains solely responsible for their tax obligations.

sections.title: 7. Mandatory billing
sections.body: The Partner must issue an invoice compliant with the regulations of their country. The invoice must include the full identity of the Partner, their tax number, the reference of the commissions, the net amount and applicable taxes. The Company may request any evidence of registration.

sections.title: 8. Partner obligations
sections.body: The Partner undertakes to act in good faith, to respect the brand and reputation of the Company, to make no contractual promises, and not to bind the Company without written authorisation.

sections.title: 9. Non-circumvention
sections.body: The Partner is prohibited from contracting directly with a referred client, diverting a business opportunity, or interfering in the execution of missions. This prohibition applies for the duration of the relationship and for 24 months after its end.

sections.title: 10. No guarantee
sections.body: The Company does not guarantee any minimum volume of activity, minimum commission amount, or territorial exclusivity. The programme is a business opportunity without obligation of result.

sections.title: 11. Termination
sections.body: The Company may suspend or terminate access to the programme at any time in case of breach of these terms, prejudicial behaviour or fraud. Commissions earned on collected amounts remain due.

sections.title: 12. Changes to the programme
sections.body: The Company may modify the commission rate, the programme rules and the payment terms. Changes become effective after publication.

sections.title: 13. Applicable law
sections.body: This programme is governed by Portuguese law. Any dispute will be subject to the competent courts of Portugal.
